categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches interfaces/wallet.h, but the IPC category explicitly excludes wallet interface changes where interface mechanics are not the point.
categories.rationale: Not an IPC member according to the category scope, which states that wallet PRs adding fields or methods to interfaces::Wallet are wallet-first unless interface mechanics are the point.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies src/wallet/interfaces.cpp to populate replacement transaction IDs on interfaces::WalletTx.
categories.rationale: Restores access to replacement transaction IDs lost during a prior cleanup of interfaces::WalletTx::value_map. Downstream consumers like gui-qml rely on these fields to show transaction replacement details.
